# Sirach Chapter 51 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 51 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**51:1** I will give thanks to you, O Lord and King, and I will praise you, O God my Savior; I give thanks to your name,

**51:2** for you have been my protector and helper and delivered my body from destruction, from the snare of a slanderous tongue, from lips that fabricate lies; and you have been my helper against those who stood against me,

**51:3** and you rescued me, in accordance with the abundance of your mercy and your name's sake, from grinding teeth about to devour me, from the hand of those who sought my life, from the many distresses that came upon me,

**51:4** from the suffocating fire on every side, and from the midst of fire that I had not kindled,

**51:5** from the deep belly of Hades, from an unclean tongue and lying words —

**51:6** from slander delivered to a king by a treacherous tongue. My soul came near to death, and my life was close to the depths of Hades.

**51:7** They surrounded me on every side and there was no helper; I looked for human help, and there was none.

**51:8** Then I called to mind your mercy, O Lord, and your work that is from everlasting; for you rescue those who wait for you and save them from the hand of their enemies.

**51:9** And I lifted my prayer from the earth, and pleaded for deliverance from death.

**51:10** I called upon the Lord, Father of my lord: "Do not abandon me in the days of affliction, in the time of arrogance, when there is no help.

**51:11** I will praise your name without ceasing and give thanks with song." And my prayer was heard,

**51:12** for you saved me from destruction and delivered me from the evil hour. Therefore I will thank you and praise you, and bless the name of the Lord.

**51:13** When I was young, before I had traveled far, I sought wisdom openly in my prayer.

**51:14** Before the temple I prayed for her, and I will seek her to the end.

**51:15** From the first blossoming to the ripening of the fruit, my heart took delight in her; my foot walked the straight path; from youth I have been in her tracks.

**51:16** I inclined my ear but a little, and I received her, and I found for myself much instruction.

**51:17** I made progress in her; to him who gives wisdom I will give glory.

**51:18** For I resolved to put her into practice, I was zealous for good, and I will not be put to shame.

**51:19** My soul strove toward her, and I was confirmed by my diligence. I stretched out my hands on high and lamented my ignorance of her.

**51:20** I directed my soul toward her, and through purity I found her; with her I gained insight from the beginning; therefore I will not be forsaken.

**51:21** My heart was stirred to seek her; therefore I have won a good possession.

**51:22** The Lord gave me a tongue as my reward, and I will use it to praise him.

**51:23** Draw near to me, you who are untaught, and take up lodging in the house of instruction.

**51:24** Why do you say you are lacking in these things, while your souls are so desperately thirsty?

**51:25** I opened my mouth and said: "Buy wisdom for yourselves without cost.

**51:26** Put your neck under her yoke and let your soul receive instruction; she is near to find.

**51:27** Look with your own eyes: I labored only a little and found for myself a great rest.

**51:28** Acquire instruction as if purchasing much silver; through her you will gain gold in abundance.

**51:29** May your soul rejoice in his mercy, and may you never be ashamed in his praise.

**51:30** Do your work before the appointed time, and he will give you your reward in due season."
